description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between cost and reliability score for three different models: 3-Model Ensemble, 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4. 
The x-axis is labeled "Cost", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 10, and has tick labels at intervals of 2. 
The y-axis is labeled "Reliability Score", has a linear scale, ranges from 30 to 90, and has tick labels at intervals of 10 and 20. 
The 3-Model Ensemble is represented by a solid blue line with circle markers, starting at a reliability score of approximately 85 at a cost of 0, decreasing steadily to around 75 at a cost of 10. 
The 2-Model Ensemble is represented by a solid red line with circular markers, beginning at a reliability score of about 84 at a cost of 0, and declining to roughly 73 at a cost of 10. 
The GPT-4 model is depicted by a solid yellow line with circular markers, starting at a reliability score of 90 at a cost of 0, and decreasing sharply to approximately 38 at a cost of 10.
